concepts.way: misconception: & and | are the same as && and || for conditions, so either can be used
concepts.why: With &, both operands are evaluated, so 10 / n runs with n = 0 and throws an ArithmeticException. The change does matter.

concepts.way: misconception: & and | are the same as && and || for conditions, so either can be used
concepts.why: The answer misses that && short-circuits and & does not, so swapping them removes the guard on the division by zero.
The answer says nothing about array default values.
